policy.name: V3
policy.note: rule chosen on validation only; test results for all variants shown side by side (integrations/playoff)

headline.note: Policy V3, Polymarket taker fees, open stake <= 1 starting bankroll, test trades entered on/after the cutoff. The rule was chosen on validation (last 20% of training). Test results for all four variants are shown side by side; V1 and V2 were proposed by teammates who had seen test numbers, so the choice used validation only.

streaks.note: With a 22% hit rate, a given run of 20 bets all loses with probability (1 - 0.22)^20; across hundreds of bets such a streak becomes likely. That is why each stake is a small slice of the bankroll (a quarter of the Kelly stake, at most 5%).
